newsitem.title: JAPAN: TSE to disclose margin trade volume in Arai-Gumi.
newsitem.headline: TSE to disclose margin trade volume in Arai-Gumi.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said on Wednesday that starting on Thursday it would disclose on a daily basis the outstanding volume of margin trades in shares of Arai-Gumi Ltd.
The action was taken as a first step to alert investors to potential investment risks amid the current heavy volume of margin trading in shares of the mid-sized general contractor.

The exchange also said it would ease restrictions on Thursday on margin trading in shares of Sumitomo Seika Chemicals Co Ltd, although it would continue to disclose the outstanding margin trade volume of its shares on a daily basis.
